boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten city-park walks and outdoor stops around Southwestern University, using Georgetown’s documented free basic parks service.

cards.title: Walk the Randy Morrow Trail
cards.subtitle: Georgetown parks trail network
cards.notes: Start at San Gabriel Park, then follow this city trail toward Rivery Park or Booty’s Road Park for a low-key walk together.
cards.short_summary: A 5.35-mile city trail linking several parks.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map identifies the 5.35-mile Randy Morrow Trail and says it starts in San Gabriel Park, connects city parks, and ends at Booty’s Road Park; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: Use the city trail map for access points; city trail hours are 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Take the Pickett Trail
cards.subtitle: Chautauqua Park to Blue Hole Park
cards.notes: Meet at Chautauqua Park and use the rocky river route to Blue Hole Park; wear closed-toe shoes for the trail’s challenging grades.
cards.short_summary: A short natural-surface route along the South San Gabriel River.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map describes Pickett Trail as a 0.5-mile rustic natural trail along the South San Gabriel River connecting Chautauqua Park and Blue Hole Park; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: The map notes challenging grades and rocky terrain; city trail hours are 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Stroll the South San Gabriel River Trail
cards.subtitle: Blue Hole Park through Chautauqua Park
cards.notes: Use this paved river route for an easy conversation walk, then pause at Blue Hole Park before continuing through Chautauqua Park.
cards.short_summary: A 4.15-mile concrete trail following the South San Gabriel River.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map identifies the 4.15-mile South San Gabriel River Trail as a concrete trail that follows the river to Blue Hole Park and through Chautauqua Park; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: Check the city trail map for route access; city trail hours are 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Loop San Gabriel Park
cards.subtitle: San Gabriel Park
cards.notes: Choose the 1.9-mile granite loop for a simple walk, then use the pedestrian bridge to connect with the city’s other mapped trails.
cards.short_summary: A 1.9-mile loop with connections at the pedestrian bridge.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map identifies the 1.9-mile San Gabriel Park Loop and says its pedestrian bridge connects with the Randy Morrow and South San Gabriel trails; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: Enter through San Gabriel Park; city trail hours are 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Follow the San Gabriel River Trail
cards.subtitle: San Gabriel Park to Katy Crossing
cards.notes: Begin inside San Gabriel Park and follow the concrete river path toward Katy Crossing for a short outdoor reset between plans.
cards.short_summary: A 0.45-mile concrete trail beside the San Gabriel River.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map identifies the 0.45-mile San Gabriel River Trail as a concrete trail from San Gabriel Park toward the Katy Crossing neighborhood; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: The mapped route begins in San Gabriel Park; city trail hours are 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Walk the Winfred H. Bonner Trail
cards.subtitle: McMaster Athletic Complex to Blue Hole Park
cards.notes: Use this one-mile lighted section for a compact walk from McMaster Athletic Complex toward Blue Hole Park with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A lighted one-mile connector in the city trail system.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map describes the Winfred H. Bonner Trail as a lighted one-mile section from McMaster Athletic Complex to Blue Hole Park; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: Access from McMaster Athletic Complex or Blue Hole Park; city trail hours are 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Use San Gabriel Park’s Disc Golf Area
cards.subtitle: San Gabriel Park · Georgetown
cards.notes: Bring discs you already own and make a casual round part of a park meetup; the city lists disc golf among the park’s amenities.
cards.short_summary: A city park with a documented disc-golf amenity and trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s parks document identifies San Gabriel Park as a 180-acre park with trails and disc golf; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.source_title: City of Georgetown Outdoor Athletic Facilities Reservation Information and Guidelines
cards.access_notes: Bring any equipment you need; reservable athletic fields are separate from casual park use.

cards.title: Hang Out at Rivery Park
cards.subtitle: 1125 Woodlawn Ave. · Georgetown
cards.notes: Use the playground and picnic area as a meeting point, then choose a mapped trail direction for a walk along the river corridor.
cards.short_summary: A city park with a playground, picnic area, fishing, disc golf, and trail access.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map lists Rivery Park at 1125 Woodlawn Ave. and identifies its playground, picnic area, disc golf, fishing, and Randy Morrow Trail access; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: Use city trail access from the park; city trail hours are 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Meet at Chautauqua Park
cards.subtitle: 602 Rucker St. · Georgetown
cards.notes: Start at the park and take the Pickett Trail along the South San Gabriel River; go at a pace that suits the group.
cards.short_summary: A named trailhead for the river-side Pickett Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map lists Chautauqua Park at 602 Rucker St. and says Pickett Trail runs from the park along the South San Gabriel River to Blue Hole Park; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: The mapped route has challenging grades and rocky terrain; city trail hours are 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Walk Through Blue Hole Park
cards.subtitle: 100 Blue Hole Park · Georgetown
cards.notes: Use this mapped park access point to meet, walk the South San Gabriel Trail, or connect onward to Pickett Trail with daylight remaining.
cards.short_summary: A city trail junction beside the South San Gabriel River.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgetown’s trails map lists Blue Hole Park at 100 Blue Hole Park and says the South San Gabriel Trail runs through it, with access to Pickett Trail; the city’s master plan states its basic level of parks service is free.
cards.access_notes: Use the marked city trail access points and observe the 5 a.m.–10 p.m. trail hours.
